content_sections.heading: Indian Coast Guard Foreman of Stores Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The number of vacancies and places of posting are tentative and may change according to service requirements. Selected candidates may be required to serve anywhere in India, including the mainland, Andaman and Nicobar Islands or Lakshadweep.

content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy either of the following qualification and experience combinations: Master’s degree in Economics, Commerce, Statistics, Business Studies or Public Administration from a recognized university or institution. One year of experience in handling stores and maintaining store accounts. Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Commerce, Statistics, Business Studies or Public Administration from a recognized university or institution; or Diploma in Material Management, Warehousing Management, Purchasing, Logistics or Public Procurement from a recognized university or institution. Two years of experience in handling stores and maintaining store accounts. The prescribed stores and accounts experience must have been gained in any of the following: Central Government organization State Government organization Statutory or autonomous organization Public Sector Undertaking University or recognized institution Bank Private-sector organization listed on an Indian stock exchange

rows.category: ST candidates applying against the reserved vacancy

rows.age_relaxation: Up to 5 years according to Central Government rules

content_sections.heading: Indian Coast Guard Foreman of Stores Salary
content_sections.text: The Foreman of Stores post carries Pay Level 6 under the applicable Central Government pay structure.

content_sections.heading: Nature of Duties
content_sections.text: Acting as custodian of the storehouse. Supervising staff working under the Foreman of Stores. Assisting senior officers in the audit of ledgers and folios. Coordinating with the audit authority. Managing inventory and disposing of scrap materials. Supervising the receipt and issue of stores in the warehouse. Ensuring effective material management. Performing other duties connected with stores and service requirements.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Indian Coast Guard Foreman of Stores selection process includes the following stages: Scrutiny of applications Shortlisting of eligible candidates Document verification Written examination Preparation of merit list based on written examination marks Admit cards will be sent by post to shortlisted candidates using the self-addressed stamped envelope enclosed with the application. The list of shortlisted candidates will also be published on the Indian Coast Guard website.

rows.examination_mode: Passing Marks for UR and EWS

content_sections.heading: Written Examination Syllabus
content_sections.text: Mathematical simplification, ratio and proportion, interest, profit and loss, percentage, work and time, speed and distance, simple mensuration, average, median and mode. Passages, prepositions, sentence correction, active and passive voice, direct and indirect speech, verbs, tense, non-finites, punctuation, phrasal verbs, synonyms, antonyms, difficult words, adjectives and compound prepositions. Indian geography, soil, rivers, mountains, ports, culture, religion, freedom movement, national facts, heritage, arts, history, defence, awards, discoveries, diseases, nutrition, current affairs, languages, capitals, currencies, abbreviations, personalities, sports and general science. Spatial and numerical reasoning, associative ability, logical reasoning, sequences, spelling unscrambling, coding and decoding, seating arrangements, blood relations, inequalities, decision-making and input-output. Supply-chain management, receipt and storage procedures, requisitioning and distribution of materials, stores equipment, maintenance of ledgers and connected documents.

content_sections.heading: Examination Centres
content_sections.text: New Mangalore Bhubaneswar The examination centre may be changed for administrative or technical reasons. The exact examination date, time and venue will be mentioned on the admit card.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required with the Application
content_sections.text: Self-attested copy of Aadhaar Card Self-attested Matriculation mark sheet and certificate Self-attested degree, postgraduate degree or diploma mark sheets and certificates, as applicable Latest ST or EWS certificate, where applicable Relevant experience certificate No Objection Certificate for candidates currently serving in a government organization Two recent passport-size colour photographs A separate self-addressed blank envelope with a Rs. 50 postal stamp affixed The Rs. 50 postal stamp is required on the self-addressed envelope and is not stated as an application fee.

faq.question: Q1. How many Foreman of Stores vacancies are available in the Indian Coast Guard?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 2 for UR, 1 for ST and 1 for EWS candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Coast Guard Foreman of Stores Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The completed application must reach the Directorate of Recruitment by ordinary post on or before 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Foreman of Stores post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 30 years old as of 3 November 2026. Applicable age relaxation is available to eligible ST candidates and Government servants.

faq.question: Q4. What is the selection process for the Indian Coast Guard Foreman of Stores post?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of application scrutiny, document verification and an 80-mark written examination. The final merit list will be prepared using written examination marks.

faq.question: Q5. Is there negative marking in the Foreman of Stores written examination?
faq.answer: No. The written examination contains 80 objective questions carrying one mark each, with no negative marking.
